name: Warrior Priest
author: Johan Markström
description: The Warrior-Priests of Sigmar stride into battle with fire burning in their eyes, chanting aloud the Deus Sigmar, the praise of the patron god of the Empire.

abilities.name: Incessant Chanting
abilities.text: Subtract 1 from the Bravery characteristic of all visible friendly fighters within 3" of this fighter.

abilities.name: Denounce
abilities.text: A fighter may use this reaction when a visible `WIZARD` uses a magical ability. Roll a d6: if the result is higher than this fighter's Bravery characteristic, the ability is cancelled and the ability dice are discarded.

abilities.name: Hammer of Sigmar
abilities.text: Until the end of this fighter's activation, add 1 to the Hit Damage and Critical Damage characteristics of their weapon. In addition, the weapon gains the blessed weapon rule.
